latest.name: Lumi Launcher v0.6.3 (Pre-review Build)
latest.body:
Pre-review build for source verification and Mojang AppID allowlist review (`732fc771-cf09-4ec5-b899-ee92fd012d57`).

> **Note:** Clicking **Sign in** launches the official Microsoft OAuth 2.0 + PKCE flow in your system browser and stops at the expected `403` Minecraft Services gate until Mojang approves Lumi's AppID. You can already explore instances, worlds, Modrinth/CurseForge discovery, and settings.
>
> NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.

### What's Changed
- Configured official pre-review builds with Lumi's Microsoft Entra public client ID (`732fc771-cf09-4ec5-b899-ee92fd012d57`) so the official Microsoft sign-in redirect can be verified directly.
- Set default Minecraft file and metadata download sources to official Mojang endpoints first.
- Removed retired legacy account shims and updated English task progress labels.
- Added public maintainer contact (`lumilauncher@outlook.com`) across documentation.

### Verification
Verify downloaded files against `SHA256SUMS.txt`:
`Get-FileHash .\LumiLauncher_0.6.3_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256`
